acceptance: Slot-1 select classifies a real PR through a live Jev call in CI (or the Jev dependency is replaced), on the pinned omp build.
description: The OMP cutover routes slot-1 reviewer selection through JevSession, which spawns `omp auth-gateway stdio` and asks model typesafe/jev-1.14.0. No available omp serves that model: the container's pinned Linux arm64 build (18.12.1, same version family as CI's pinned x64 build) answers 404 No available model matches for jev-1.14.0, jev-latest, and jev-preview, with and without TYPESAFE_API_KEY set, despite the typesafe credential being present and the catalog row existing. The host (18.12.3) 404s identically, and plain `omp --print --model typesafe/jev-latest` reports model not found. Anthropic chat through the same gateway path works, so credential sharing is fine; only the typesafe judge route is missing. Until this is resolved, every merged-cutover run will fall into slot-1 pending (classification unavailable) and never reach a reviewer. Either vendor the Jev capability into a pinned omp build, or replace the live-Jev classification dependency before merge.
